capabilities: hide the window to the system tray instead of quitting
show, hide, relaunch or fully quit Obsidian from the tray icon menu
show one tray icon per open vault with the vault name in tooltip and menu
restore the existing window instead of the vault picker when relaunching
customize the tray icon and tooltip with the {{vault}} placeholder
extras: Desktop only: Windows and macOS are fully supported, Linux support is best-effort. Installable via BRAT for beta versions, and versions are date-based (e.g. 1.09.13 = 2026-09-13).
intentEvidence: A robust, modern reimplementation of the (now unmaintained) obsidian-tray, built for Obsidian / Electron in 2026.
motivation: The predecessor obsidian-tray is unmaintained, so the author rebuilt it as a modern implementation for current Obsidian and Electron.
problem: Obsidian quits entirely when you close its window, pausing background sync and forcing a cold start with the vault picker when you reopen it.

relations.evidence: A robust, modern reimplementation of the (now unmaintained) obsidian-tray, built for Obsidian / Electron in 2026.

summary: System tray plugin that keeps Obsidian running in the background when the window is closed, with one tray icon per vault.
